CARE THAT MOVES WITH YOU

Physiotherapy

Understand your movement. Find your way forward.

Physiotherapy begins with understanding how your symptoms affect your movement and everyday life. An assessment can help you explore the next steps towards your own goals.

UNDERSTANDING YOUR OPTIONS

What is involved?

Your physiotherapist may assess movement, strength, and balance, alongside a conversation about your health history. Your plan may include exercise, hands-on treatment, and advice on managing symptoms.

What to expect

Your appointment is a chance to ask questions, share your priorities, and understand the proposed approach.

  • Your symptoms and how they affect your day
  • Movement, strength, and everyday activities
  • A practical plan with agreed goals

Before your visit

Wear comfortable clothing and bring any relevant referral letters, scan reports, or instructions from another healthcare professional. Make a note of the questions you would like to ask.

Your questions, answered.

Do I need to choose a technique first?+

No. An initial assessment is a place to discuss your concerns and explore suitable options together.

How many sessions will I need?+

The plan depends on your assessment, goals, and response. Discuss a review point with your physiotherapist rather than assuming a fixed number of visits.

How do I make an enquiry?+

The enquiry button opens our booking page with this treatment selected. Add your preferences and download your request. The clinic must confirm availability before an appointment is booked.
